$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (pl column), checked against WordByWordPrototype/Localizable.xcstrings (pl values) and the quota screen (FeatureQuotaManager.swift featureDisplayName); §7.2.2 rules ①–③ (no X-fix lists pl); §7.3 pl row (ty, imperative; "przesuń w prawo", "dotknij dwukrotnie" — the doc 03 draft "Stuknij dwa razy" is corrected to the app wording).

required: kickers and quota-table rows use the app's names (rule ①). Kickers drop the "(Znaczenie AI)" suffix like en / ja / es / fr; the quota rows follow the app's own comparison screen: daily_sentence_translation_limit + engine (the app shows "(Chmurowy silnik tłumaczeń)" / "(Silnik lokalny)"; shortened to "· w chmurze" / "· lokalnie" so each row fits the 390 px table), word_meaning_lookup_title, more_definitions_title, ai_pronunciation_word / _sentence, audio_playback_title_local, Chunk Extraction, sentence_skeleton_settings_navigation_title, grammar_structure_analysis. Action Flow keeps the App Store name in headings and the sample label (doc 08 D3, §7.2.3); the app's "Przebieg działań" is quoted in features[chunks].text.

contains: app button and setting names quoted verbatim in „ ” (rule ①; T-E for faq.items[restore]); the app writes them in English-style title case ("Uaktualnij Teraz", "Przywróć Zakup", "Zdanie po Zdaniu", "Lokalne Czytanie") — quoted as the app shows them, reported to the app side in docs/redesign-2026/ops/m3/pl-qa.md.

banned: left swipes (F14); mouse wording for the double tap (the legacy pl site wrote "kliknij dwukrotnie" / "podwójne kliknięcie"); a single tap for lookup (doc 08 §1.1); "stuknij dwa razy" (the doc 03 draft; the site follows the app's "dotknij dwukrotnie", doc 08 §7.3); selecting text to translate (legacy "przez zaznaczenie", C-09; also claims-lint selection-translate); "wyrównanie" for the display modes (jargon, C-16); the generic "inteligentny asystent" (doc 08 §7.4, legacy title); other names for More Definitions. Patterns use \s so they also match the copy's no-break spaces (U+00A0).

banned.note: the gesture is a right swipe; a left swipe removes the translation (F14)
touch gesture, not a mouse double-click (doc 08 §7.2.2 X7 by analogy; the legacy pl site)
lookup is a double tap, never a single tap (doc 08 §1.1 lookup row)
the app's wording (word_meaning_lookup_title, tip_double_tap_context_meaning); doc 08 §7.3 corrects the doc 03 draft
no select-to-translate in the iOS app (legacy pl "przez zaznaczenie tekstu", C-09; claims-lint selection-translate)
jargon for the display modes (doc 08 §7.5, C-16; legacy "wyrównanie zdanie po zdaniu")

banned.use: asystent czytania (only in the definition sentence)
banned.note: generic "smart assistant" wording (doc 08 §7.4; the legacy pl title)
